groups.oneLine: Shows with the switch off (every user). The main script grows from 380 KB to 643 KB (gzip 137 KB to 233 KB): a cold visit of the web page shows the editor 85 ms later at 10 Mbit/s and 190 ms later at 4 Mbit/s; with a warm cache there is no difference, locally (desktop-like) about 12 ms.

JS received before the editor exists 334 791 B vs 237 865 B (x1.41). Time from navigation to .cm-content, no cache, alternating, 4 samples per build and run: at 10 Mbit/s candidate 401 / 400 / 405 ms vs 0.1.1 315 / 315 / 317 ms (x1.27, x1.27, x1.28; every candidate sample slower than every 0.1.1 sample); idle 539 / 537 / 539 vs 454 / 452 / 454 ms (x1.19).
